data.name: Majeedan
data.gender_notes: Majeedan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'majid', meaning 'glorious' or 'honored'. In Islamic tradition, it is also associated with Allah's name 'Al-Majid', which signifies His greatness and majesty. The name Majeedan carries the meaning “Honored, Proud, Majestic” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Majeedan usually hope their child will grow to embody honored, proud, majestic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the greatness and majesty of Allah.
data.etymology: Majeedan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honored, Proud, Majestic.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majeedan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
